name: Laurel South
description_short: Coed overnight camp on Crescent Lake in Casco, Maine, for campers who have completed grades 2 to 9, with about 200 boys and 200 girls each 3.5-week session. Individually scheduled programs in athletics, waterfront, tennis, adventure and Inter-Arts, with in-camp leagues and intercamp teams.
swim_waterfront_notes: On 3-mile-long Crescent Lake; the camp says the lake is naturally warmed and reaches about 80 degrees during the day.

warnings: The page doesn't say whether the $10,800 tuition is for one session or the whole summer. Session prices are left blank.
On top of tuition, the page lists Trip Day Expenses of $300, optional Equestrian for $600, and transportation that 'varies by location'.
The page says nothing directly about overnight stays. It is listed as sleepaway because each session runs about 3.5 weeks without a break.
unknowns: Whether the tuition is per session or for the full summer
How many spots are left in each session
Whether meals are included (likely, but not stated)
